observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a vehicle gearbox/transfer case housing with the bellhousing area exposed; metal casing shows wear and dirt; several mounting points visible.
Photo 1: Side view of the same gearbox/transfer case; heavy grime and scuffs on the casing; a round cover/plug area and linkage/hoses/brackets are visible.

Photo 2: Gearbox/transfer case interior visible with gears/gear train and a central shaft; a separate large metal bell/torque-converter-like housing/cover is placed beside it; both parts show surface wear.
